اقشعررن (form IVq)
# اِقْشَعْرَرْنَ (iqšaʕrarna) /iq.ʃaʕ.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# اِقْشَعْرِرْنَ (iqšaʕrirna) /iq.ʃaʕ.rir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
